mapper.sql: FROM ai_care_alert a JOIN elder e ON e.id=a.elder_id LEFT JOIN ai_alert_read_receipt r ON r.alert_id=a.id AND r.staff_id=#{staffId} WHERE a.state != 'RESOLVED' AND COALESCE(r.seen_notice_revision,0) < a.notice_revision
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_alert_read_receipt(staff_id,alert_id,seen_notice_revision,read_at) VALUES(#{staffId},#{alertId},#{revision},NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE read_at=IF(seen_notice_revision < VALUES(seen_notice_revision),VALUES(read_at),read_at), seen_notice_revision=GREATEST(seen_notice_revision,VALUES(seen_notice_revision))
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN lease_until > NOW(3) THEN 'RUNNING' WHEN last_error IS NOT NULL THEN 'RETRY_PENDING' ELSE 'IDLE' END AS state, scan_date AS scanDate,target_date AS targetDate,last_completed_date AS lastCompletedDate, last_success_at AS lastSuccessAt,next_scan_at AS nextScanAt FROM ai_alert_scan_checkpoint WHERE id=1
